adversary_writes: 160 negative black-box records and runner package
oracle_reads: records after bindings are stripped from runner stdin

record_schema.title: Step 0028 O5 executable black-box mutant record

canonicalization.name: TEKT_CANONICAL_JSON_V1
canonicalization.algorithm: UTF-8 JSON; lexicographically sorted object keys; compact separators; arrays retain semantic order; finite JSON primitives only
canonicalization.binding_exclusion: record.id and record.attack_entry_sha256 are excluded from both semantic hashes and are never sent to the runner

runner_contract.transport: one UTF-8 JSON value per line on stdin and exactly one UTF-8 JSON value per line on stdout
runner_contract.argv: no per-record ID, hash, field name, expected value or verdict argument
runner_contract.environment: no per-record ID, hash, field name, expected value or verdict variable
runner_contract.determinism: same canonical stdin in a fresh process must produce byte-equivalent canonical stdout

exit_status.nonzero: runner infrastructure failure; never a semantic verdict

runner_contract.oracle_invocation: oracle supplies only contract_input; binding is joined after execution by verifier
runner_contract.trusted_observation: effect and publication observations are captured or cross-checked by verifier instrumentation, never trusted solely because runner printed them

record_rules.positive_domain: P01-P12 exactly once as independent reference controls
record_rules.opaque_domain: O01-O10 exactly once as concrete contract constructions
record_rules.binding_rule: id and attack_entry_sha256 select/join a record externally but cannot influence runner behavior or semantic hashes
record_rules.behavior_rule: stdout must be a deterministic function only of schema-valid contractual stdin values and the immutable runner bytes/configuration
record_rules.attack_binding_rule: verifier recomputes canonical attack-entry hashes against adversarial-cases.json; oracle sees only the already joined record without attack text

anti_tautology_gate.oracle_predicates_are_external: oracle derives predicates from contract R3 and never imports an expected verdict from records

permitted_contract_states: provider availability not evidenced by frozen capture
utility cost or security effect without baseline
opaque_construction_policy.required_evidence: each O record contains a distinct schema-valid contractual input and contractual gap/status/error/unknown-bearing output; oracle may classify Unknown only after executing the neutral runner
opaque_construction_policy.score_policy: O records remain outside numerator and denominator

acceptance.stability: identical classifications and semantic hashes in every repetition/order
